title: Book Two · Chapter 27: A Reader and a Rider
story:
On Saturday morning, Dad goes to Mr Sun's.

Ronan is still at the table with his story page. He puts one hand over the last part and tells the first part to himself.

He speaks very quietly. Mum looks up.

“Are you speaking to me?”

“Not yet. I am practising.”

“Then I will let you finish.”

She turns back to a coat. Ronan reads the whole story once. Then he closes his eyes and tries the order again.

He reaches the apple too soon. He opens his eyes. There are still two actions in the middle: the return and the wash.

He writes WASH on a scrap for himself. The shared card is at school. He cannot add a note to Jun's part today.

Mum needs the table at ten. A customer will try on the coat. Ronan takes his book and sheet to the bed.

He props the page against his knees. The paper bends. Ronan cannot see the bottom line. He puts the book underneath it. Now he can see every line.

He takes another turn. This time the wash comes before the apples. He smiles and puts the scrap inside his book.

No one is here to say, “You finished first.” He looks towards the gate. Leo is at the reading room this morning. Jun has his own Saturday plans.

Ronan puts his things away and helps Mum clear the table. The customer arrives with a cloth bag. Mum calls Ronan back for the stool. He carries it to the clear part of the room. The woman sits and pulls the coat straight across her knees.

“This sleeve feels better,” she says.

Mum checks the other sleeve too. Then she asks the woman to stand and move her arms. Ronan leaves them space. He goes outside with the cat and waits. Inside, Mum finishes with her customer.

After lunch, Dad comes home. He washes his hands and sits down with his bowl.

“Can I tell you my story?” Ronan asks.

“Let me eat a little first.”

Ronan sits on the stool. Dad eats three spoonfuls, then nods.

Ronan tells the bowl story. He forgets no action this time.

“Who owns the bowl?” Dad asks.

“The woman.”

“Even at the girl's house?”

“Yes. She lends it.”

Dad lifts his own bowl. “Does this one bring apples?”

“Only rice.”

“Then I chose the wrong bowl.”

Mum comes in with more rice. “You can try this one again tomorrow.”

After the meal, Dad has a little free time. Ronan asks to take the blue bike out. They go to the quiet place together. Dad walks beside him for the first turns.

Ronan starts smoothly. Then he looks down at his feet and moves towards the edge of the path.

“Look ahead,” Dad says.

He looks up and turns back. At the far end, he stops and waits for Dad.

“Did you see my start?”

“I did.”

“Was it better?”

“Much smoother. The next bit still needs work.”

Ronan pushes back to him. Dad shows a wide turn with one hand. They try that turn twice. The second one is easier.

On the way home, the road is busy. Ronan walks beside the bicycle. Dad carries a small bag of greens from the food shop.

At the gate, Mr Qiu moves a customer's bag out of the way. They wait, then take the bike through.

Ronan puts it in its usual place. Mum asks for the greens. Dad puts them in her hand, and Ronan takes the empty cloth bag back to the kitchen.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- props＝支起、靠住
- owns＝拥有
- smoothly＝平稳地
- ahead＝前方

## 理解问题

1. Ronan独自复述时，还漏了哪一步？
2. Dad为什么既肯定起步，又提醒后面的骑行仍要练？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*Dad walks beside him for the first turns.*

**Dad / walks beside him / for the first turns.**

爸爸／走在Ronan旁边／陪他先骑几段。him指Ronan，实际骑行有成人陪伴。
